subtasks.title: Claims query reads the view
subtasks.approach: UniqueLprCaseClaimsQuery selects from {clarity_db}.billing_claim_events_v. Alias org_id as forwarder_org_id. Filter is_internal = 0, event_type, ts BETWEEN, an event_date bound covering that span, and the either-side org predicate. Delete orgs, the needle joins, kept, JSONExtract, and public_api_keys. Window and monthlySeries use one SELECT: count, countIf(success), uniqExactIf of BillingClaimDedup::tripleSql(). Pre-claim reads hotlist_id and ts from the view and keeps the hits_cold join and h.hotlist_id != 0. Docblock: not a ClickhouseQuery; does not read clarity.orgs; no type IN (1, 2) paragraph. Seed clarity.billing_claim_events in the feature test.
